description: Connect an existing owned meeting and its retained recordings to a CRM customer, including finished meetings. Use exactly one of roomId or latest:true, and exactly one of leadId or customer. latest:true means the most recent meeting whose start time has passed, excluding cancellations; equal start times require clarification. Resolve named customers uniquely; never guess IDs or drop the customer on a lookup error. Replaces any existing customer association. Does not invite or notify anyone, publish a replay, change recording permissions, or start recording. Return the actual linked meeting and customer from the result.
name: link_meeting_customer
